blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Authorities have recovered the motorcycle allegedly used by a riding-in-tandem gunmen who fired several shots at a woman’s vehicle along Chino Roces Avenue in Makati City. The shooting, which left the victim wounded, occurred around 6:50 a.m. on Thursday along Chino Roces Avenue in front of Unibank and BDO, beside Oriental Place in Barangay Pio del Pilar.
